message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Databricks Agent Bricks Knowledge Assistant

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks Agent Bricks knowledge assistant empowers you to create, deploy, and manage AI agents directly within the Azure Databricks platform, using unified data and AI capabilities. This feature simplifies agent development by providing prebuilt components, secure integration with enterprise data, and scalable orchestration. With Agent Bricks, you can accelerate automation, enhance decision-making, and deliver personalized experiences all while maintaining compliance and governance standards under the Azure ecosystem. By combining the flexibility of open-source frameworks with the enterprise-grade security and reliability of Azure, Agent Bricks makes it easier for you to build high-quality, production-ready AI agents at scale with Azure Databricks. 

Learn more.
